slides.title: A Thinking Partner, Not a Data Source
bullets: ChatGPT's main value for an MSL is structuring strategic thinking, not fact lookup
Other specialized tools offer more reliable scientific data
It helps organize ideas, explore angles, and speed up first drafts
Verification and refinement always stay with the MSL

slides.title: Building a Medical Plan or Account Strategy
bullets: Feed it the situation: competitive landscape, evidence gaps, objectives
Ask it to organize those pieces into a logical framework
It can surface questions the MSL hadn't considered
The MSL still revises with verified primary source data

slides.title: Simulating Difficult KOL Conversations
bullets: Ask ChatGPT to role play a skeptical or critical KOL
Useful for rehearsing objection handling from Module 4
Builds confidence before the real, high stakes conversation
Never substitutes real product and evidence knowledge

slides.title: General Productivity Tasks
bullets: Summarizing long documents
Drafting first structures for presentations
Adapting the same content for different formats and audiences
Turning a technical summary into an accessible explanation

slides.title: What ChatGPT Should Never Be Used For
bullets: Never a primary source for specific clinical data: doses, trial results, statistics
Always verify such figures against the original publication or label
Never enter confidential company data, unpublished results, or identifiable patient or HCP information
These information security rules are covered fully in Lesson 9

takeaway.title: ChatGPT earns its place as a strategic thinking accelerator, never as a source of clinical facts
bullets: Strongest use cases are Medical Plan structuring, objection rehearsal, and drafting
Specific clinical data always needs primary source verification
Confidential or patient identifiable information must never enter a prompt
